title: Trevor O NDE 6573
date: Between the second and fourth weekend of October 2012.
content: It was a Friday or Saturday night and it was a few weeks into my first semester at college as a freshman. I was with six of my friends, just relaxing outside. We decided to play some basketball, so my friend David went to get his basketball. While waiting for him, we started playing ‘horse’ and I was running around on the concrete in bare feet, trying to show off to my new friends. While running across the court, I tripped and scraped my right big toe on the concrete and ripped it apart. At first, I was fine except that it stung. After maybe a few minutes, I felt that I had to sit down. My friends were fine with it and went on to start a basketball game. So, I walked up the little hill above the basketball court, sat down, and that's when, apparently, I passed out. When I passed out (I can't say whether I stopped breathing or not) I saw only darkness. Absolute darkness, and from a basic knowledge of different cultures, I quickly realized that it was the ‘void,’ or the ‘abyss.’ As I came to that conclusion, several hooded beings of an ethereal-looking faded sepia color appeared. There were at least three or four of them on my left side and I believe the same amount on my right. For some reason I focused more on the beings on the right side. (When they came to me at first, my rational thoughts quickly told me that these were just my friends. I thought that they had realized I had passed out and were surrounding me. However, it turned out not to be them.) The beings stood around me, paused a bit, and then began to lift me up into a tunnel of light. At first, I felt content and sufficiently warm in this void-darkness. When I realized what was going on, I began to yell and tried to shake my way out of it. However, I found I could not yell. There was just silence. It seemed to me that I had no body, but the only things I could see were things that were right in front of me, and I had no idea whether my body was with me. (Later I concluded that my soul had left my body, yet there is nothing to confirm that.) Once I made it through the light tunnel, I came to, lying on the ground on my back, moaning and rolling around on the grass. My vision came back, and once I was able to sit up and look around, I saw that my friends were still down on the basketball court playing basketball. Whether or not my heart had stopped beating, I cannot say. But I believe that it was more than a dream, because here, in January, I can still remember the experience, fresh in my mind.

arrival.other_being_detail: Several hooded beings of an ethereal-looking faded sepia color (at least three or four on each side) appeared in the darkness/void and lifted him up into a tunnel of light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out after tripping and severely scraping/ripping his right big toe on concrete while playing basketball.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Hooded beings appeared in the void/darkness and lifted him into a tunnel of light; he attempted to yell but there was silence; he then returned to awareness in his body on the ground.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/void with hooded beings preceded the tunnel of light; no clear 'arrival' realm beyond the tunnel was described before returning to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Hooded, ethereal sepia-colored beings in a void/abyss lifted him into a tunnel of light; he tried to yell but could not (silence).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw only darkness. Absolute darkness… it was the ‘void,’ or the ‘abyss.’”
